title: 1.1: Removes the verify boolean parameter from the WithDetectors function signature in pkg/engine/engine.go
1.2: Creates a new WithVerify option function to control verification independently in pkg/engine/engine.go
1.3: Stores verification configuration at the Engine level in pkg/engine/engine.go instead of per detector
1.4: Uses the Engine-level verify setting for chunk verification in pkg/engine/engine.go instead of per-detector ShouldVerify
1.5: Updates main.go to pass verification via WithVerify instead of through WithDetectors
2.1: Adds documentation for both new verification API surfaces (verify field, WithVerify function) in pkg/engine/engine.go

3.1: Misbuilds the keyword-to-detector-type mappings in NewAhoCorasickCore, causing MatchString or PopulateDetectorsByMatch to miss a matched detector type, add a type whose keyword did not match, or return no detector for a matched type in pkg/engine/ahocorasickcore.go
3.2: Adds redundant verify fields to internal structs (such as, AhoCorasickCore, detectableChunk) instead of using the single Engine.verify field in pkg/engine/engine.go
